headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for AudioControl Concert XR receivers. Expose power, volume-preset, and source-preset switches over the LAN IP control port (default 50000). On the receiver, set **Control** to **IP** and **Standby Mode** to **IP and HDMI ON** so the unit remains reachable while in standby. One receiver per Homebridge. A second receiver needs its own Homebridge.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Plugin instance name shown in the Homebridge log.

host.title: Host / IP Address
host.description: IP address or hostname only. Put the port in Control Port. A value that includes a port is rejected and the plugin will not start. Prefer a static address or a DHCP reservation.

port.title: Control Port
port.description: TCP port for IP automation control. Default is 50000. Out-of-range values fall back to 50000 at startup.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional model name shown in HomeKit Accessory Information. Longer than 64 characters, HomeKit truncates it.

accessories.title: Accessories
accessories.description: HomeKit switches for this receiver. Each type, zone, and volume or source can appear once. A duplicate is rejected and the plugin will not start.

type.title: Type
type.description: power turns the zone on, or puts it into standby. volumePreset is On when the zone is at the configured volume step; turning it On sets that step, and turning it Off leaves the volume alone. sourcePreset is On when the zone is on the configured input; turning it On selects that input, and turning it Off leaves the input alone.

name.title: HomeKit Name
name.description: Display name in the Home app, 64 characters or fewer. A longer name is rejected and the plugin will not start. Renaming a switch keeps its room and automations.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Zone 1 is the main zone. Zone 2 can follow Zone 1. DISPLAY is Zone 1 only.

volume.title: Volume Level
volume.description: The receiver's own volume step, 0–99, the same number it shows. Turning the switch On jumps to this step from any current level. Turning it Off leaves the level alone. Changing this later creates a new HomeKit switch and drops that switch's room and automations.

source.title: Input Source
source.description: The receiver's input type, such as CD or BD, even when the front panel shows a different label. DISPLAY works on Zone 1 only. Turning the switch On selects this input. Turning it Off leaves the input alone. Changing this later creates a new HomeKit switch and drops that switch's room and automations.

refreshRate.title: Refresh Rate (seconds)
refreshRate.description: How often to poll the receiver for accessory state. Default 90 seconds. Values below 5 fall back to 90; values above 86400 are clamped.

pagerdutySignals.title: Send Signals to PagerDuty
pagerdutySignals.description: Off by default. When on, writes receiver-offline for homebridge-pagerduty. Install that plugin, allow homebridge-concert to page, and restart. Needs Node 22.13 or later. On an older Node 22 this plugin still runs, logs that signals were skipped, and does not page.
